title: Storm Sorceress Over Ruins
description: A powerful sorceress with long flowing white hair floats in the stormy sky, wielding a glowing blue magical staff that summons a massive swirling tornado of blue energy and debris descending upon a ruined city and harbor filled with wrecked ships. Military fighter jets fly through the dark, lightning-filled clouds above the apocalyptic scene.
